verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਨਤ ਨ ਸਗਨ ਲਗਨ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaanat na sagan lagan aan dhev sev sabadh surat liv neh nira(n)kaaree hai ||

en.bdb: Engrossed in the Guru's holy feet, the Sikh is unaware of the omens or service of gods and goddesses. He remains aborbed in such inaccessible love with the True Guru by lodging the divine word of the True Guru in his consciousness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਖ ਸੰਤ ਬਾਲਕ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਹੁਇ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥੪੪੮॥
verses.translit_en: sikh sa(n)t baalak sree gur pratipaalak hui jeevan mukat gat braham beechaaree hai ||448||

en.bdb: The father Guru protects and brings up the specially virtuous children. Such Sikhs are freed of all rites and rituals by the Guru during their life-time, and instills the ideology and thoughts of one Lord in their mind.  (448)
